/*selectMasterMpSoOrderStandbyOrderReqHeaderPopList*/ SELECT A.BUYER , A.PR_NO , A.REF_NO , E.PR_SUBJECT , C.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NM , F.DEPT_NAME AS PURCH_DEPT , D.USER_NAME_LOC AS PURCHASER , E.CHANGE_DATE FROM ICOMPRDT A , ICOMCQDT B , ICOMCMPY C , ICOMLUSR D , ICOMPRHD E , (SELECT COMPANY_CODE , TEXT1 DEPT_NAME , CODE DEPT_CODE FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' ) F WHERE 1=1 AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ= B.CONTRACT_SEQ(+) AND A.BUYER = C.COM_CODE(+) AND A.PURCHASER_ID = D.USER_ID(+) AND A.BUYER = E.BUYER(+) AND A.PR_NO = E.PR_NO(+) AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.PURCHASER_DEPT = F.DEPT_CODE(+) AND A.BUYER = F.COMPANY_CODE(+)
AND B.STATUS(+) ^= 'D' AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PR_NO = #{st_pr_no} GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.PR_NO,A.REF_NO , E.PR_SUBJECT , C.COM_NAME_LOC , F.DEPT_NAME , D.USER_NAME_LOC , E.CHANGE_DATE ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.PR_NO, A.REF_NO

/*selectMasterMpSoOrderStandbyOrderReqDetailPopList*/ SELECT A.BUYER , A.PR_NO , A.PR_SEQ , A.REF_NO , (SELECT to_char(MAX(PASSLN.PASS_DATE),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') FROM ICOMTRGW TRGW , ICOGDOCU DOCU , ICOGPASSLN PASSLN WHERE TRGW.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND TRGW.KEY_1 = A.REF_NO AND TRGW.COM_CODE = DOCU.COMPANY AND TRGW.TARGET = DOCU.DOCU_NO AND DOCU.COMPANY = PASSLN.COMPANY AND DOCU.DOCU_NO = PASSLN.DOCU_NO AND CUR_ORDER_NO = PASSLN.ORDER_NO AND PASSLN.PASS_TP = '1' ) PASS_DATE , DECODE(B.AGENT,A.AGENT,'OK',NULL ,'계약서없음','공급사오류') AS AGENT_ERROR , DECODE(B.UNIT_PRICE,A.TARGET_PRICE,'OK',NULL ,'계약서없음' ,'판매단가오류') AS UNIT_ERROR , DECODE(B.LIST_PRICE,A.LIST_PRICE,'OK' ,NULL ,'계약서없음 |' ,'매입단가오류 |') AS LIST_ERROR , A.TARGET_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE --매출단가_주문 , A.LIST_PRICE AS LIST_PRICE --매입단가_주문 , A.AGENT --협력사_주문 ,(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME , NVL(B.AGENT,'NULL') AS C_AGENT --협력사_계약 ,(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = B.AGENT) AS C_AGENT_NAME , NVL(B.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS C_UNIT_PRICE --매출단가_계약 , NVL(B.LIST_PRICE,0) AS C_LIST_PRICE --매입단가_계약 , A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO --품목코드 , A.CONTRACT_NO --계약서 번호 , A.CONTRACT_SEQ --계약서 항번 FROM ICOMPRDT A , ICOMCQDT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ= B.CONTRACT_SEQ(+) AND B.STATUS(+) ^= 'D' AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.PR_NO = #{st_pr_no}
